findings.issue: Non-name adverb with directional suffix (H6924) is left as the transliteration kedmah, so the licensed directional sense is omitted.
Definite construct (place of the ash) is rendered indefinite: a lugar omits the definiteness licensed by the article on the nomen rectum.

notes: Quitar, buche, con su pluma, arrojar, junto al altar, and ceniza match the lemmas, stems, and suffixes.
